reviews.x: I purchased this for my kinda newly natural type 4, low porosity hair and of course I'm so mad that I didn't get it earlier. My bottle doesn't leak, works perfect with every refill and is a time and mess saver for me!   The fine continuous mist gets into my strands MUCH easier than with my regular spray bottle that doesn't mist allowing me to use less water and be more direct with my application (if that's understandable).   If you're a lo-po and you often spray your hair, GET THIS BOTTLE👍🏽

I filled it with water on the day I received it, to test it. It worked fine. I emptied it and put it away in my bathroom cabinet. Yesterday I filled it with water to use it on my hair and it would not spray. I purchased this because I hoped that for $15 I would get a better product than the $5 bottles but it's worse than the cheap ones.  I wish I could get my money back.

I've found this spray mist bottle to be extremely helpful in evenly moisturizing my insanely thick, curly hair.  Those of y'all who also have untamable curls are probably familiar with the struggle of trying to moisten your hair with a normal spray bottle, only to end up with some sections soaked and some barely damp.  This mister is indeed a life saver.  Never again will you suffer with clumpy wet hair!  I have always mixed a few squirts of conditioner with tap water (no precise measurement) in

reviews.t: It's true, it smells moldy after a few uses.
reviews.x: I saw some reviews stating it starts smelling moldy after a while; it took about two weeks for me. The spraying action is excellent, but the smell clings to hair. I tried to empty it every night to dry it out, washed it with soap and vinegar, the smell was there to stay, I had to toss it. I've seen different versions of this mister used by hairdressers, and it never smelled. Not sure what it is. I just switch to the regular spray bottle to avoid frustration.

I put water in here mixed with lavendar essential oil to spray on carpet. It has a spray that lasts about 3 seconds with one squeeze so you have to squeeze less times and your hand doesn't get as tired as a regular spray bottle.

reviews.t: It releases a powerful mist in one spray.
reviews.x: I wanted a spray bottle that would evenly distribute my leave in conditioner and water mixture to my hair. This bottle was suggested by my sister and even though it was a little pricey, it works fine for spraying just the water. It gives a good mist in one spray and evenly damps my hair once I am finished. I would have liked to mix my conditioner, water, and oil together in it. But the manual doesn't recommend it. Stating that it may clog the spray. This limits what I truly need the bottle for.

Works great with water. Saw some reviews saying that you had to get versions with a bag to spray any way other than upright, but I've used this sideways and upside down and still had it work. VERY rarely, I'll fill and close it, and it won't spray however much I try; but it's easily fixed by putting the top on--but not sealed-- just enough to reach the water and squeezing the trigger until it sprays before properly closing/sealing the top for normal use. It produces a nice, long mist.

This squirt bottle is pretty great. I am always looking for one to either help my kids with their hair before school or squirt water on my ironing.  The squeeze handle is easy yet responsive. You can squeeze quickly and get a quick squirt or squeeze longer for a longer squirt. I love it and will be getting more to have on hand in each bathroom.

Honestly, I was a bit skeptical because of the cost and my spray bottle has worked fine in the past. However, having super curly hair, I often wake up with semi-ready-to-go hair needing just a bit of reviving. I had purchased one of these bottles a few months back and was so pleased with how it sprays that I ordered a 2nd one for my sister. The mist is perfect for refreshing 2nd and 3rd day curls. It dispenses a gentle mist, not at all like other spray bottles which often drench your hair and require numerous pulls on the trigger. This bottle puts out a great mist and it sprays for a longer period of time with just one pull on the trigger. I am confident you will be pleased with your purchase.

Yes these are expensive, but let me tell you if you make anything homemade from air fresheners, to body sprays, to hairsprays, or even to water plants this is for you and it’s worth every dime! This is honestly the coolest thing I’ve bought an in a long time, and I ended up buying four of them I liked them so much. I use a couple of drops of essential oil and add water and it makes perfect room freshener and calm down spray for my kids !

[[VIDEOID:343c36a74d477da774d97cb211236c37]] Love this! Even when full it’s lightweight and easy to travel with. Has a continuous mist as advertised and still allows short pumps of water if that is desired. Love it. I’m  going to buy a few more for homemade essential oil room misters.

I have never owned a mister/spray bottle and this thing is amazing. Super small water droplets get into hair strands better without getting it super wet. Much easier to manage curly/frizzy hair after a few quick sprays! You won’t regret getting this!!

reviews.t: Save your money. Go with another brand.
reviews.x: This product was worthless. It did not work properly and stopped working after using twice. I didn’t return because I don’t want another one. I threw it away and would never buy this item again. I wouldn’t trust this product.

I’ve had this bottle for a few months now and it works just fine as far as the continuous mist goes. However, the water gets this musty smell no matter what I do. I’ve tried cleaning it several times, changing the water out frequently, emptying it after every use and letting it air out, and no matter what the water still seems to get a musty smell after sitting for a day or more. I don’t know what else would help, but I wish this wasn’t such an issue.

When hair needs a quick and refreshing blow dry, this is the tool to have!  Throw away the water spray bottles purchased at various retailers that send streaks of water down your neck, back and shoulders.  This bottle emits the finest mist, just enough to allow you to refresh your style.  Learned about it at my last salon visit and immediately when home and purchased.  The size is stylish, comfortable to use and is available in both black or white.

This is not sponsored. I used my earned coin to purchase this magical product!! I have curly hair and have purchased my fair share of spray bottles to tame my wild lioness hair. This one right here baby does the trick and works like a charm. Believe the hype. It’s good.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the fine, continuous mist effective for evenly moisturizing thick or curly hair.
Several reviewers report the bottle stops working or fails after limited use.
Some reviewers say the bottle develops a moldy smell after a few uses that clings to hair.
Reviewers praise the long continuous spray that reduces hand fatigue and works in various orientations.
Some reviewers consider it pricey but worth it, and several repurchase or buy multiple.
